public_hook.note: The Hinglish phrase is private-feeling but broadly readable for the channel's desi couple audience. Visual proof must make the relationship dynamic clear without caption help.

relationship_obstacle.note: The phrase risks sounding like obedience; the deck repairs it into agency and belonging.

concrete_receipts.note: Plan change, argument reschedule, terms slip, scoreboard reversal, and theek-hai exhibit are clear relationship receipts.

active_partner_role.note: Zuv changes, reschedules, signs, crosses out the score, and brings the phrase as a love object.

swipe_ladder.note: Private phrase hook -> alternate-universe receipt -> status receipt -> terms receipt -> meaning reversal -> sendable phrase payoff.

send_save_thesis.note: The final slide says what viewers send to their own theek-hai person.

visual_non_generic.note: The artifact system is original, but output must be checked because image models can drift into generic stationery or photoreal meme stills.

hard_fails_checked: not a passive saintly Zuv deck
not a generic AI romance scene set
not a copied external screenshot or logo
proof_gate: Generate and approve Slide 1 before any full batch.
